note: Authored for this release from the team's own working skill for reading a Mac's iCloud Photos library with osxphotos and PhotoKit. Read-only: no script modifies, deletes or uploads library items. No photo, catalog, face cluster id, contact sheet, path or other personal data from the author's library is bundled; every command is a template. fetch.py was checked by downloading one iCloud-only photo; video download is not separately verified. No EVALS.md ships yet, so no benefit over an agent without the Skill is claimed.
